from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
import numpy as np

def bernstein_vazirani_setup(n):
    qr_data = QuantumRegister(n, 'data')
    qr_ancilla = QuantumRegister(1, 'ancilla')
    cr = ClassicalRegister(n)
    circuit = QuantumCircuit(qr_data, qr_ancilla, cr)

    circuit.ry(np.pi, qr_ancilla)  # Flip the ancilla to |1>
    circuit.barrier()

    for i in range(n):
        circuit.h(qr_data[i])  # Apply Hadamards to all data qubits

    circuit.barrier()

    return circuit

    # Measure every qubit
    for i in range(num_qubits):
        circuit.measure(qr[i], cr[i])
